{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=12–16|time=60+ minutes|difficulty=4|image=[[Image:Layered_cake_with_rye_bread_2.jpg|300px]]}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Denmark|Cuisine of Denmark]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

'''Rugbrødslagkage''' (Danish for "rye bread layered cake") is a cake with whipped cream and layers of grated rye bread. Layered cakes of this type are eaten at birthday parties in Denmark, but this recipe with rye bread is quite rare.

==Ingredients==

* 125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] dark [[Cookbook:Rye|rye]] bread without [[Cookbook:Sunflower Seeds|sunflower seeds]] etc.
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 250 g granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 15 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]]) [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
* 15 ml (1 tbsp) [[Cookbook:Potato Flour|potato flour]]
* 5 ml (1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]]) [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]] for greasing baking paper
* 500 ml [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]] for whipping

==Procedure==
===Three days before serving ===

# Leave a couple of slices of unwrapped rye bread to dry outside of the fridge.

=== The day before serving ===

# [[Cookbook:Grater|Grate]] the now-dry rye bread.
# Turn on [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 220°C (or 200°C for convection ovens).
# [[Cookbook:Separating Eggs|Separate]] the eggs and [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] the egg whites to stiff peaks.
# In a separate bowl, whip the egg yolk with sugar, cocoa, potato flour, baking powder, and grated rye bread. Carefully [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in the beaten whites with a spoon.
# Spread the batter 1 cm thick on buttered [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|baking paper]] in a [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake form]]. The dough should be enough for 4 or 5 layers. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10 minutes at 220°C. Only in case of convection oven, more layers can be baked above each other. 
# Let the layers cool completely.
# Whip two-thirds of the cream, and spread it between the layers. Cover and chill in the fridge overnight.

===Just before serving ===

# Cover top and sides with whipped cream.

== Gallery ==
<gallery mode="packed">
File:Grating rye bread.jpg|First step: grate the dry (!) rye bread
File:Beating egg whites before yolk.jpg|Beat egg whites first, then egg yolk
File:Baking cake layer 1.JPG|Prepare dough for a cake layer on buttered baking paper
File:Baking cake layer 2.JPG|After 10 min: A single baked cake layer
File:Layered cake with cream.JPG|Just before cutting!
</gallery>
==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Leaving the half-done cake in the fridge overnight improves the taste.
